from fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, HTTPException, Query
from fastapi.responses import JSONResponse
from fastapi.security import HTTPBearer, HTTPAuthorizationCredentials
from starlette.middleware.base import BaseHTTPMiddleware
from services.db import connect
from models.account import Account, AccountCreate, AccountUpdate
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy.exc import IntegrityError
from datetime import datetime

router = APIRouter()

security = HTTPBearer()

class PassthroughAuth(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def dispatch(self, request, call_next):
        response = await call_next(request)
        return response

@router.get("/accounts", response_model=list[Account])
async def get_accounts(
    include_archived: bool = Query(False),
    db: Session = Depends(connect)
):
    query = db.query(Account)
    if not include_archived:
        query = query.filter(Account.archived_at.is_(None))
    return query.all()

@router.post("/accounts", response_model=Account)
async def create_account(
    account: AccountCreate,
    db: Session = Depends(connect)
):
    db_account = Account(**account.dict())
    db.add(db_account)
    try:
        db.commit()
        db.refresh(db_account)
    except IntegrityError:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=400, detail="Account already exists")
    return db_account

@router.get("/accounts/{id}", response_model=Account)
async def get_account(
    id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(connect)
):
    db_account = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == id).first()
    if not db_account:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account not found")
    return db_account

@router.put("/accounts/{id}", response_model=Account)
async def update_account(
    id: int,
    account: AccountUpdate,
    db: Session = Depends(connect)
):
    db_account = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == id).first()
    if not db_account:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account not found")
    for key, value in account.dict(exclude_unset=True).items():
        setattr(db_account, key, value)
    db.commit()
    db.refresh(db_account)
    return db_account

@router.delete("/accounts/{id}", response_model=JSONResponse)
async def delete_account(
    id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(connect)
):
    db_account = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == id).first()
    if not db_account:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account not found")
    if db_account.archived_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Account is already archived")
    db.delete(db_account)
    db.commit()
    return JSONResponse(content={"detail": "Account deleted"})

@router.post("/accounts/{id}/archive", response_model=JSONResponse)
async def archive_account(
    id: int,
    db: Session = Depends(connect)
):
    db_account = db.query(Account).filter(Account.id == id).first()
    if not db_account:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="Account not found")
    if db_account.archived_at:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Account is already archived")
    db_account.archived_at = datetime.utcnow()
    db.commit()
    return JSONResponse(content={"detail": "Account archived"})
